children.game_version: A rhythmic ring game where children pass or strike lightweight sticks to the dhol beat, changing direction when the drum accent sounds.

seniors.seated_version: Perform stick striking patterns while seated in a circle, coordinating strikes with neighbors on the drum pulse without foot travel.
seniors.standing_version: Stand in place or step gently in a stationary circle, striking sticks without performing full half-swirls or rapid ring swaps.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Moderate, steady tempo; limit arm reach to comfortable chest height.

feedback_rules.description: Ensure stick strikes coincide with the percussion pulse to preserve consistent group tempo.

learning_units.description: Clockwise and counter-clockwise circular stepping in concentric rings while striking khanda sticks.
Executing half-swirl rotations to flare pleated tunics during all-male or mixed circle sequences.

prerequisites.description: Coordination to walk or step rhythmically in a circle while striking hand-held sticks with partners.

social_formats.description: Concentric group circles of men and women alternating inner and outer positions, or groups formed exclusively by men.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Striking slender khanda sticks together or wielding swords and arrows
movement_profile.footwork: Series of intricate pattern steps and directional circle changes
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Large circular formations, often concentric, traveling clockwise and counter-clockwise
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Half-swirl rotations that open out the pleated tunics
movement_profile.partnering: Concentric circle exchanges between men and women, striking sticks across partners

signature_moves.description: A rotational turning movement that causes the pleated skirts of the tunic to flare outward.
signature_moves.name: Half-swirl

signature_moves.description: Rhythmic beating together of wooden sticks cut from the Gundi tree to determine tempo and invoke martial scenes.
signature_moves.name: Khanda striking

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid careless stick or sword handling that could cause injury during close circular passes.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Vigorous, consistent pulse driven by synchronized stick striking and drumbeats
music_profile.sound_description: A driving percussive soundscape anchored by the resonance of dhol, dholak, and nagada drums, intertwined with melodious flute lines and the sharp, consistent rhythmic clacking of wooden khanda sticks or swords.

basic_steps: Form two concentric circles, with women in the inner circle and men in the outer circle
Step rhythmically in a clockwise direction while striking khanda sticks in time with the drums
Reverse direction to travel counter-clockwise around the circle
Execute half-swirl turns to flare the pleated tunic or skirt
Switch circle layers, moving men into the inner circle and women to the outer ring
teaching.formation: Concentric circles (inner and outer rings) moving clockwise and counter-clockwise
teaching.level_notes: Beginners execute simpler versions focused on half-swirls and steady stick striking, while proficient dancers perform intricate footwork patterns.
teaching.rhythm: Steady, consistent tempo driven by stick strikes and percussion
